The path branches away from River Street.

data.situation:
On Friday morning, an unexpected call interrupted Maya's breakfast. The plumber had found damage beneath the floor near the main entrance. The organisers had to put off the repair demonstration until Sunday so that the plumber could work in the hall on Saturday afternoon. Maya called the demonstrator immediately, before he set out to load his van. Maya: I'm sorry to put you off at short notice, but we need to cancel our Friday afternoon meeting. Can we speak by phone this evening instead?
Lin: Yes. I'll keep the evening free.
Maya: Thank you. I need to make provision for visitors to use a different entrance tomorrow. Unforeseen repairs have closed the main entrance. The hall manager will return on Monday. In the interim, Maya Chen will act as interim manager.
Please use the courtyard gate on Saturday. A narrow path leads off River Street beside the bakery. Follow it to the blue gate.
The main entrance will reopen on Monday. Thereafter, visitors can use the usual door. By the door, Lin found an older booking form. It asked organisers to explain what they would do if an unforeseeable event made the hall unusable. Maya had written a contact number and an alternative meeting place. The space for an alternative meeting place was still blank on another organiser’s form. Lin left that one for Maya and followed the path beside the bakery. At the blue gate, the new sign was already in place.

readingBlocks.en: On Friday morning, an unexpected call interrupted Maya's breakfast. The plumber had found damage beneath the floor near the main entrance. The organisers had to put off the repair demonstration until Sunday so that the plumber could work in the hall on Saturday afternoon. Maya called the demonstrator immediately, before he set out to load his van.
readingBlocks.zh: 周五早晨，一个意外来电打断了玛雅的早餐。水管工发现主入口附近的地板下有损坏。组织者不得不把维修演示推迟到周日，好让水管工周六下午在会堂作业。玛雅立即打电话给演示者，赶在他出门装车之前告诉了他。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: I'm sorry to put you off at short notice, but we need to cancel our Friday afternoon meeting. Can we speak by phone this evening instead?
Lin: Yes. I'll keep the evening free.
Maya: Thank you. I need to make provision for visitors to use a different entrance tomorrow.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：抱歉临时取消和你的约见，但我们得取消周五下午的会面。今晚可以改成电话沟通吗？
林：可以。我会留出晚上这段时间。
玛雅：谢谢。我需要为明天访客改用另一个入口作安排。

readingBlocks.en:
Unforeseen repairs have closed the main entrance. The hall manager will return on Monday. In the interim, Maya Chen will act as interim manager.
Please use the courtyard gate on Saturday. A narrow path leads off River Street beside the bakery. Follow it to the blue gate.
The main entrance will reopen on Monday. Thereafter, visitors can use the usual door.
readingBlocks.zh:
未预料到的维修使主入口关闭。会堂经理周一回来。在此期间，玛雅·陈将担任临时经理。
周六请使用院门。面包店旁有一条从河街岔出去的小路。沿路走到蓝色院门。
主入口周一重新开放。此后，访客可以使用通常的门。
readingBlocks.title: At the closed entrance

readingBlocks.en: By the door, Lin found an older booking form. It asked organisers to explain what they would do if an unforeseeable event made the hall unusable. Maya had written a contact number and an alternative meeting place. The space for an alternative meeting place was still blank on another organiser’s form. Lin left that one for Maya and followed the path beside the bakery. At the blue gate, the new sign was already in place.
readingBlocks.zh: 门旁，林发现一份旧场地预订表。表格要求组织者说明：如果无法预见的事件导致会堂无法使用，他们会怎么办。玛雅写下了联系号码和一个备用会面地点。另一位组织者的表格上，备用会面地点那一栏仍空着。林把那张表留给玛雅，沿着面包店旁的小路走去。蓝色院门处，新指示牌已经放好。

glossary.note: 日常描述出乎预期的来电；不等于无法预见。
glossary.example: An unexpected call interrupted Maya’s breakfast.
glossary.exampleZh: 一个意外来电打断了玛雅的早餐。

glossary.note: put something off until + 日期，将某事改到较晚日期；与取消和某人的约见分开。
glossary.example: They put off the repair demonstration until Sunday.
glossary.exampleZh: 他们把维修演示推迟到周日。

externalEvidence.definition: hold back to a later time

externalEvidence.findingZh: put something off表示改到较晚日期。

glossary.note: put somebody off在本句表示取消已经约好的会面；与put something off延期、以及让人反感的用法区分。
glossary.example: I’m sorry to put you off at short notice.
glossary.exampleZh: 抱歉临时取消和你的约见。

externalEvidence.findingZh: put somebody off可取消与某人的约见；object语法与延期分开。

glossary.note: 副词表示没有耽搁；不是位置上的紧挨着。
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅立即打电话给演示者。

externalEvidence.definition: without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening

glossary.note: make provision for + 名词或带逻辑主语的to结构；为未来需要事先安排。
glossary.example: We need to make provision for visitors to use a different entrance.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们需要为访客改用另一个入口作安排。

externalEvidence.findingZh: make provision for表示为未来需要准备或作安排。

glossary.note: 强调事实未被预料；不声称它客观上不可能预见。
glossary.example: Unforeseen repairs have closed the main entrance.
glossary.exampleZh: 未预料到的维修使主入口关闭。

glossary.note: 形容词用于名词前，interim manager为正式负责人回来之前的临时经理。
glossary.example: Maya will act as interim manager until Monday.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅将担任临时经理，直到周一。

externalEvidence.definition: serving during an intermediate interval of time

glossary.zh: 在此期间；在两件事之间的这段时间
glossary.note: 整块表示现在到经理回来之间的时段，不是最后或永久。
glossary.example: The manager returns on Monday. In the interim, Maya is in charge.
glossary.exampleZh: 经理周一回来。在此期间，玛雅负责。

externalEvidence.findingZh: 在两事之间的一段时间；须明确经理回来是终点。

glossary.note: 较正式，适合书面通知；以周一重新开放作为时间参照。
glossary.example: The entrance reopens on Monday. Thereafter, visitors can use the usual door.
glossary.exampleZh: 入口周一重新开放。此后访客可使用通常的门。

glossary.zh: 从某处岔出；从某处开始延伸
glossary.note: 道路或小路作主语，lead off + 起始地点；不是lead something off开始一场活动。
glossary.example: A narrow path leads off River Street beside the bakery.
glossary.exampleZh: 面包店旁一条小路从河街岔出去。

externalEvidence.findingZh: lead off (from) a place表示道路从该地点开始延伸或岔出。

glossary.note: 用于假设的无法预见事件；不能因为自己没有预料就断言某事无法预见。
glossary.example: The booking form asks about an unforeseeable event that could close the hall.
glossary.exampleZh: 预订表询问可能导致会堂关闭的无法预见事件。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell the demonstrator the new date and explain why you called quickly.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 告诉演示者新日期，并说明为何迅速打电话。
acceptableAnswers: An unexpected call brought news of the repairs. We have put off the demonstration until Sunday. I called immediately so you would not load the van for Saturday.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell Lin who is in charge while the manager is away and what arrangement visitors need.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 告诉林经理不在期间谁负责，以及访客需要什么安排。
acceptableAnswers: In the interim, Maya is the interim manager. We need to make provision for visitors to use the courtyard gate.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain how to find Saturday’s entrance and when the usual door can be used again.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明怎样找到周六的入口，以及何时能再次使用通常的门。
acceptableAnswers: A path leads off River Street beside the bakery. The main entrance reopens on Monday; thereafter, visitors can use the usual door.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Write a short entrance notice about the unanticipated repairs. Then add a separate line to the booking form explaining what to do if an event that could not be predicted makes the hall unusable.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 写一条入口短通知，说明未预料到的维修。再在预订表另写一行，说明若无法预见的事件使会堂不能使用，该怎么办。
acceptableAnswers: Unforeseen repairs have closed the main entrance. If an unforeseeable event makes the hall unusable, call Maya and meet at the alternative venue.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: You must cancel an appointment with a friend at short notice. Apologise and offer a phone call instead.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 你必须临时取消与朋友的约见。道歉并提出改打电话。
acceptableAnswers: I’m sorry to put you off at short notice. Could we speak by phone instead?
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
